biggest_catch: IntelliZoom (now part of UserTesting/UserZoom) publishes no official tester-facing page stating concrete pay amounts or a payment schedule.
catches: The only official document found (help.usertesting.com IntelliZoom onboarding article) covers PayPal data collection and consent for recordings — not pay amounts or timing.
All pay figures ($2-$10/study, paid within ~21 business days via PayPal) come from third-party review sites (SurveyPolice, lushdollar, myroomismyoffice).
IntelliZoom has been absorbed into UserTesting/UserZoom, so the legacy panel's terms are in flux.
Study availability is low (~1-2 invites/week per reviewers).
